items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle); missed 5 games on hammy in 2024. MRI results expected tomorrow. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27.
items.why: Injured during Wed practice; prior hamstring history
items.implication: MRI critical; potential multi-week absence elevates other HOU WRs
items.opportunity: High prior route share (37/42); next-man-up volume

items.text: Patriots placed A.J. Brown on IR with high-ankle sprain; no surgery needed, earliest return Week 6 vs Jets.
items.implication: Misses at least 4 games; NE WR targets redistribute
items.opportunity: Slot/route rate for DeMario Douglas, Mack Hollins, Kyle Williams

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold (glute) for Sunday vs Cardinals; no plans for IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; SEA offense/pass-catchers impacted short-term

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.implication: Bateman/Moore see more; Flowers (if healthy) and Andrews primary
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman route rate nearly every dropback Week 1

items.text: Deebo Samuel is top waiver wire target this week after Stribling IR; 21% target share and red-zone work in Week 1 make him must-add.
items.why: Stribling IR opens role; strong Week 1 usage
items.implication: Priority add in all formats for immediate WR2/FLEX upside

items.text: 49ers placed De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) on IR (at least 4 weeks, ~10 weeks post-surgery). Deebo Samuel led slot routes Week 1 and stands to gain snaps/targets; also Demarcus Robinson.
items.implication: Deebo upgrade for next month+; drop Stribling in most leagues
items.opportunity: Deebo 21% target share + 3 RZ targets Week 1; role expansion

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance Week 2 or 3 return; same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise. DNP Wed practice, day-to-day, not overly serious per reports.
items.why: Meniscus trim ~1 week ago; team cautious but hopeful
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri practice; Mayer fills in; latest Week 4
items.opportunity: If OUT, Mayer TE2 upside; reverse if unexpectedly ACTIVE

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Handled nearly all early opps + high route/target share as expected
items.implication: Every-down RB1 with receiving upside; handcuff Emma Johnson

items.text: ETR first Rest of Season Top-150 live discussing rankings if season started today: CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty, Jalen Coker and more with opportunity adjustments.
items.implication: Trade value shifts; buy/sell based on role changes

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor practice; JK Dobbins/others could gain if limited/out

items.text: Jameson Williams had 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game (efficiency disaster).
items.why: High xFP from targets/location but poor realization
items.implication: Positive regression candidate; hold/start with confidence
items.opportunity: Underlying opportunity strong despite box score

items.text: Vikings RB Jordan Mason small thumb fracture fixed; short-term IR, should return quickly. Added DeeJay Dallas.
items.implication: Temporary absence; handcuff/backup value rises short-term
items.opportunity: Aaron Jones or Dallas volume bump

items.text: Travis Hunter limited specialized package Week 1 (4 offensive snaps: jet sweep, screens, decoy); no routes past LOS. Jags intentions clear given Meyers extension and BTJ interest.
items.why: Extremely limited role matching offseason signals
items.implication: Long season but low immediate fantasy value; not drawing dead yet

items.text: Rashee Rice high routes (29/33 Mahomes dropbacks) but tiny 2.5 aDOT (career 4.9); only 2 targets (7% share). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: Routes present but low aDOT and target share in debut
items.implication: Volume-dependent; ROS ranking adjustment possible if targets rise
items.opportunity: High route participation; Worthy also heavy
